text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo, the Umamusume who always runs 
away at full throttle until she's gassed 
out. Today, she played tag with her 
classmate Nice Nature again and got 
caught...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, she's timid, terrible with 
starting gates, and gets easily bored. But 
if she can overcome all those issues—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo's goal. She might even stand a 
chance against her classmate Tokai Teio, 
who is hailed as a future Triple Crown 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, let's resolve the issues at hand 
and make it to her debut.
